finding: An already active opensInNewWindow=false request can be rebound into another scene if its URL is delivered there. The previous window view declared no external-event preference.
public_solution: Dynamically prefer request=<owned UUID> through SwiftUI handlesExternalEvents(preferring:allowing:), retaining the existing new-window/current-window decision for new requests.
preserved: The actual request/result store, original engines, existing UUID WindowGroup, per-scene binding, and main catalog opening are unchanged by this focused follow-up. No global window registry or test-only navigation API.

api_verification.semantics: URL absoluteString matching is case and diacritic insensitive; a preferred existing scene wins over a scene that only allows the event.

required_verification: Real original-app root-inline epsilon request survives another request closing to catalog; select it through native iPad window UI, then deliver its duplicate OS URL and require the same PID, one owned window, original edited value/counter/prepared callback before returning.
